hook.headline: Will the Avengers Tower retire soon?

forecast.caption:
LEGO Marvel Avengers Tower (76269) launched at $499.99 and is still in production, so secondary prices usually track MSRP until it retires.

Big appreciation tends to start after EOL, when sealed units get scarce—this is a long-hold, not a quick flip.

Current sources indicate it will stay on shelves through at least late 2028.
